clue.text: Failure when coating of drive cable broken

indicators.note: the coating of a word is its outside, so take the first and last letters of drive
something broken is smashed up, so the letters of cable are rearranged

explanation.surface: A mechanic finds the car failed because the insulation on a drive cable snapped.
explanation.definitionFit: A fiasco or humiliating collapse is a total failure, the core sense of the word.

clue.text: Clue fort in part of London

parts.note: read as 'clue for T': the end of the word east is the letter T

explanation.surface: A puzzle setter's hint about an old fort somewhere in the capital.
explanation.walkthrough: Split 'fort' as 'for t': the clue wants a phrase that, read as wordplay, gives the letter T. The last letter of EAST is T. The EAST END is the old working-class district of east London.
explanation.definitionFit: The East End is a district of the capital east of the City, famous for docks and Cockneys.

clue.text: Cart inspection

parts.note: split as car plus the letter t: an Audi is a make of car
the letter t left over once the first word is split as car plus t

explanation.surface: A cart being checked over, perhaps at a market.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cart' must be split into 'car' and 't': AUDI for the car, then T as written.
explanation.definitionFit: An audit is a formal examination or inspection, typically of accounts.

clue.text: Many a servant wants to hold you back

indicators.note: one word holding another contains it, so the old you goes inside

parts.note: to want is to lack, so wants gives lacks

indicators.note: back means the word for you is read backwards

parts.note: ye is the old form of you

explanation.surface: A servant hopes his employer will keep him on and stop him leaving.
explanation.definitionFit: Lackeys are footmen or servile attendants, so many servants, one plural for another.

clue.text: Affected charm as court breaks up marriage

indicators.note: a piece that breaks up another splits it open, so the court abbreviation sits inside

parts.note: a marriage is a union of two people

explanation.surface: A divorce court ends a marriage, with one party putting on a show of charm.
explanation.definitionFit: Besides anointing, the word means an unctuous, insincere manner: affected, oily charm.

clue.text: Figure showing more dead

definitions.meaning: a figure is a numeral or digit
dead here means without feeling, numb, so more dead is more numb, the comparative

explanation.surface: A figure showing more dead people, like a casualty count.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the second sense as NUMB plus ER, rhyming with 'plumber', not as a count.
explanation.definitionFit: A number is a figure or numeral; as a comparative adjective it means more lacking in sensation.

clue.text: Tease at least in a different way

indicators.note: doing something in a different way means the letters of at least in are reordered

explanation.surface: Teasing someone, at least, in a different way than usual.
explanation.definitionFit: To tantalise is to torment by offering something just out of reach, a cruel form of teasing.

clue.text: Exclusion from tournament for failure to start

indicators.note: a word that fails to start has lost its first letter

parts.note: a medieval tournament was a jousting contest

explanation.surface: A competitor is excluded from a tournament for failing to turn up at the start.
explanation.definitionFit: Ousting someone is ejecting or expelling them, so the act is an exclusion.

clue.text: Of this 24 essentially get out

parts.note: the answer to 24 across is, in essence, the UK getting out of a bloc of European states

explanation.surface: A political slogan: in essence, leave this.
explanation.walkthrough: 24 across names the UK's 2016 vote to leave; the clue describes what was left.
explanation.definitionFit: The UK's departure was from the economic and political bloc of European member states.

clue.text: Old American edition

parts.note: US is short for American, as in United States

explanation.surface: An old copy of an American printing of a book.
explanation.definitionFit: Something second-hand or worn from service is old, the sense in a pre-owned car.

clue.text: Being friendly, mum turns trendy, when captivated by game

indicators.note: captivated by means held inside, so the middle part goes within the game

parts.note: chess is a board game

indicators.note: turns here means the first letter of mum rotates round to the end

parts.note: IN means fashionable, trendy

explanation.surface: Mother suddenly becomes trendy and friendly while engrossed in a game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turns' here is a rotation, not a reversal: reading the word backwards would change nothing, so its first letter moves to the end, making UMM.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun names the quality of being matey and sociable, so a gerund phrase for warmth fits.

clue.text: Be very angry with the following view

indicators.note: following means the second piece comes after the first

parts.note: to view is to see

explanation.surface: Someone fumes at the view that follows.
explanation.definitionFit: To seethe is to boil with suppressed rage, a vivid image of intense anger.

clue.text: As Dido and Aeneas say, a spirit measure takes time

indicators.note: a piece that takes another holds it within

parts.note: an optic is the device on an upturned bottle in a British pub that dispenses a fixed measure of spirits
an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: A barman pours measures of spirit for two characters, taking his time.
explanation.walkthrough: An OPTIC is the British pub dispenser on an upturned spirits bottle.
explanation.definitionFit: Dido and Aeneas is Purcell's opera, so its characters or style are an example of things from opera.

clue.text: Dead wrong about cocktail, may be spoken to

indicators.note: about means the jumbled letters go around the other piece
wrong means the letters of dead are put into a wrong order

parts.note: a cocktail is short for a cocktail dress, a dress for parties

explanation.surface: Someone completely wrong about a cocktail gets a talking-to.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrong' reorders the letters of 'Dead' to ADED. 'Cocktail' stands for a cocktail dress, a short party dress.
explanation.definitionFit: To be addressed is to be directly talked to by a speaker, a past participle for a passive phrase.

clue.text: Information about infiltrating rogue Red Sea rebels

indicators.note: infiltrating means getting inside the other piece
rogue suggests going astray, so the letters of red sea are rearranged
about here means turned around, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: gen is British slang for information

explanation.surface: Intelligence about spies sneaking into a band of rogue rebels by the Red Sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Renegades are deserters or traitors to a cause, a kind of rebel.

clue.text: Lord with an exotic lineage

indicators.note: exotic suggests something strange, so letters are rearranged: the answer plus an together make up lineage

explanation.surface: A nobleman with a foreign family background.
explanation.walkthrough: A composite: the answer's letters and AN, mixed up, make LINEAGE.
explanation.definitionFit: A liege was a feudal superior to whom vassals owed allegiance, a lord.

clue.text: Shift inside just in time to tighten belts

indicators.note: inside means the letters sit within the words just in time

explanation.surface: A work shift brought in just in time for staff to tighten their belts.
explanation.walkthrough: Two definitions sandwich the wordplay: 'Shift' as a spell of work, and 'to tighten belts' as the verb meaning to economise.
explanation.definitionFit: A stint is a fixed spell of work, like a shift; as a verb it means to skimp or economise.

clue.text: Rent a party twister

parts.note: rent as the past of rend means torn
a do is a party

explanation.surface: Hiring a party game with a twisting theme.
explanation.definitionFit: A twister is American slang for a violent rotating windstorm.

clue.text: One's in some Asian country or another

indicators.note: in means one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: India is an Asian country
taken as ones, the plural of one

explanation.surface: One belongs in some Asian country or other.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' points back to 'some Asian country': the result is a second Asian nation.
explanation.definitionFit: The answer is another Asian nation, an archipelago state, so 'another' in context defines it.

clue.text: Lost heart over sustained 24 opponent

indicators.note: in a down clue over means the first piece sits above the second
the heart of a word is its middle letters

parts.note: borne means carried or sustained

explanation.surface: An opponent of leaving has lost heart, having held on long.
explanation.definitionFit: George Osborne, Chancellor in 2016, campaigned to remain in the EU, so he opposed leaving.

clue.text: Copy upset a timing component

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the letters read from bottom to top, so the run is taken backwards
a component is a part, so the letters form a part of the words that follow

explanation.surface: A faulty timing component being copied.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' looks like one word but works as two: 'up' is the reversal signal for a down entry, and 'set' starts the hidden run inside 'set a timing'.
explanation.definitionFit: To imitate is to mimic or reproduce, so it means to copy.

clue.text: Several layers of stone missing from plan

indicators.note: missing from means taken out of the plan word

parts.note: a stratagem is a scheme or plan
a gem is a precious stone

explanation.surface: A building plan left out several layers of stonework.
explanation.definitionFit: Strata are layers of rock, plural, so several layers.

clue.text: Screw badly, then drive out

parts.note: frig is vulgar slang for screw

indicators.note: badly means the letters of then are put in a wrong order

explanation.surface: A DIY job botched, after which the car is driven off.
explanation.definitionFit: To scare people off is to drive them out through fear.

clue.text: Why European no longer inside

indicators.note: inside means the former goes within the other piece

parts.note: a Brit, a British person, is a European
ex means former, no longer

explanation.surface: The reason a European is no longer inside the club.
explanation.definitionFit: The 2016 vote and departure explain why the UK stopped being a member of the European bloc.

clue.text: Arouse girl to secure consent

indicators.note: to secure is to hold fast, so one piece holds the other inside

parts.note: Eve is a girl's name
OK is to consent or approve

explanation.surface: Stirring a girl's feelings to win her agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: To evoke a memory or feeling is to call it up, to arouse it.

clue.text: Difficult delivery of sentence

definitions.meaning: a prison term of punishing physical work

explanation.surface: A tough childbirth, or a tough job delivering a sentence.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names both a long, painful childbirth and a penal sentence of heavy work.

clue.text: It's about talking and listening, when talking

indicators.note: when talking means the word is said out loud and sounds like another

parts.note: aural means relating to hearing or listening

explanation.surface: A language exam covering speaking and listening skills.
explanation.definitionFit: Oral means spoken, concerning speech, so a test or skill that is about talking.

clue.text: Maxim's grass salad

parts.note: sods are pieces of turf, grass
slaw, as in coleslaw, is a cabbage salad

explanation.surface: Maxim's, a Paris restaurant, serves a salad of grass.
explanation.definitionFit: The rule that anything that can go wrong will is a jokey principle or adage of British life.

clue.text: Note before and during charge for judge

indicators.note: before means the note comes first

parts.note: re is the second note of the sol-fa scale

indicators.note: during means inside the charge word

parts.note: a fee is a charge
the same note used again

explanation.surface: A musical note played before and during the charge for a judge's services.
explanation.walkthrough: The single word 'Note' does service twice, as 'before and during' implies: the same note goes both in front and inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A referee is an official who adjudicates a match, a judge of play.
